note: Reference definitions for the two Retell custom functions. Create them in Retell (Functions > Add > Custom Function) using these values. Replace YOUR_N8N with your n8n Cloud domain. Keep 'Payload: args only' OFF so the body is { name, call, args }. Add the header X-Receptionist-Secret with the same value as the n8n 'Retell tool secret' credential.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Get the next open appointment times for routine visits. Call this after you know what the caller needs and before offering times.

preferred_date.description: Earliest date the caller wants, as YYYY-MM-DD (convert words like 'tomorrow' using the current date). Omit if they have no preference.

part_of_day.description: Morning or afternoon preference, if the caller gave one.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book the visit the caller chose and send them a confirmation text. Only call after the caller picks one of the offered times and you have all details.
tools.execution_message: One moment while I book that.

start.description: The exact 'start' value from check_availability for the time the caller chose.

problem.description: Short description of the problem in the caller's words.

service.description: Closest service type from the business's list.

someone_on_site.description: Whether someone will be at the property, e.g. 'yes' or 'no, key under mat'.

language.description: Language code the call was held in, e.g. 'en' or 'es'.
